title: Completion
description: Gray text after the cursor in VS Code, from the model in the fast slot: whether it is on, how long it waits after a keystroke, and whether it writes a few lines after a line that opens a block.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The kind and version this file is written in; always its first field.

title.description: The name clients show for this record; the file's own name when empty.
title.title: Title

enabled.description: Suggest the rest of the line as you type in VS Code; off: nothing is asked.
enabled.title: On

delay_ms.description: How long, in milliseconds, VS Code waits after you stop typing before it asks for a suggestion.
delay_ms.title: Wait

lines.description: one: the rest of the line; few: also a few lines on an empty line after one that opens a block (ending with :, {, ( or [).
lines.title: Lines
